caseStudies.title: An early-stage social enterprise gets funding-ready
caseStudies.situation: A community food initiative had a strong mission and loyal volunteers, but no formal business or impact plan — which was starting to block funding applications.
caseStudies.approach: From Idea to Action programme, combining Business Planning and Social Development services over six weeks.
caseStudies.quote: We finally had a plan that matched how seriously we took the mission.

results.label: from first session to a funding-ready plan
funding applications submitted using the new plan
theory of change document the team still uses

caseStudies.title: A growing training company restructures around clarity
caseStudies.situation: A 12-person training provider had grown quickly, but roles had blurred, deadlines were slipping, and decisions bottlenecked around the founder.
caseStudies.approach: Organisational Development combined with the Organisation Growth Accelerator programme.
caseStudies.quote: We stopped firefighting and started running the business on purpose.

results.label: to a working growth roadmap with quarterly milestones
documented decision-making process replacing informal habits

caseStudies.title: A volunteer-led initiative starts measuring its impact
caseStudies.situation: A community mentoring group had been running informally for two years and wanted to show funders and partners the difference it was making.
caseStudies.approach: Social Impact Development programme, including a needs assessment and outcome measurement framework.
caseStudies.quote: For the first time we could actually show our numbers, not just tell our story.

results.label: outcome measurement framework built from scratch
new partnership conversations opened using the results
